sms_unit_cost_usd.unit: USD per outbound SMS to Saudi Arabia

hlr_lookup_cost_usd.unit: USD per Line Type Intelligence lookup

recaptcha_cost_usd.unit: USD per assessment beyond the free tier

legit_conversion.unit: fraction of legitimate OTP sends that are verified
legit_conversion.source: Twilio reports a 65 %+ global SMS OTP conversion rate; well-run flows sit higher. 0.80 is ASSUMED within that range. https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/validate-measure-success-verify-implementation

legit_verify_delay_s.unit: seconds from send to code entry
legit_verify_delay_s.source: SMS delivery is typically 2 to 5 s and 67 % of users abandon if the code takes over 30 s; a median of 25 s with lognormal spread is ASSUMED to match. https://www.messagecentral.com/blog/customizable-otp-timeouts

recaptcha_human_scores.unit: Beta distribution of v3 scores for humans (mean 0.86)
recaptcha_human_scores.source: ASSUMED. Google publishes no distribution; the admin console shows it per site.

recaptcha_bot_scores.source: ASSUMED. Solving services sell v3 tokens at 0.3 to 5 USD per 1000, so a farmed score distribution equal to humans is the conservative choice. https://research.aimultiple.com/captcha-solving-services

captcha_solve_cost_usd.unit: USD per solved reCAPTCHA v3 token
captcha_solve_cost_usd.source: 2.89 USD per 1000 (EndCaptcha) to 5 USD per 1000 (2Captcha) for v3; https://research.aimultiple.com/captcha-solving-services

residential_proxy_cost_per_gb_usd.source: Entry prices 1 to 8 USD per GB across major providers in 2025, https://www.techradar.com/features/cheapest-proxy-servers

request_bytes.unit: bytes per OTP request round trip through a proxy
request_bytes.source: ASSUMED (TLS handshake plus a small JSON body).

pumping_revenue_share.unit: fraction of the termination fee paid to the fraudster
pumping_revenue_share.source: ASSUMED range. Public reports describe a share of the termination fee without a figure; https://cybelangel.com/blog/sms-pumping-fraud-telecom-attack/ , https://www.ericsson.com/en/reports-and-papers/white-papers/ait-the-root-cause-the-solution-and-the-implication-on-rcs-and-network-apis

cgnat_prevalence_mobile.unit: fraction of mobile data networks deploying CGN
cgnat_prevalence_mobile.source: Richter et al., A Multi-perspective Analysis of Carrier-Grade NAT Deployment, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.05606

legit_traffic_rate_per_min.unit: legitimate OTP requests per minute at the source under test
legit_traffic_rate_per_min.source: ASSUMED; scaled in the low-and-slow study.

legit_fresh_fingerprint_fraction.unit: fraction of legitimate sign-ups from a browser never seen before
legit_fresh_fingerprint_fraction.source: ASSUMED (sign-up traffic is mostly new visitors).
